description: This file implements a PHP class ADODB_sqlite3, serving as a database driver for SQLite3 within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes methods for database connection, transaction management, schema inspection, and BLOB handling, along with a recordset class for fetching query results.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlite3
classes.description: Database driver class for SQLite3, providing methods for connecting, transaction control, schema inspection, and Blob handling within the ADOdb framework.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlite3
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results from SQLite3, supporting field fetching, seeking, and dataset navigation.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the SQLite3 server version and description.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if successful, or rolls back otherwise.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Determines the ADOdb meta type for a given SQLite3 column type.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table, including name, type, size, nullability, and primary key status.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Extracts foreign key constraints of a specified table using SQLite master table and regex parsing.

methods.name: charMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for character fields; no limit in SQLite.

methods.name: textMax
methods.description: Returns maximum size for text fields; no limit in SQLite.

methods.name: month
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract month component from date.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract day component from date.

methods.name: year
methods.description: Generates SQL to extract year component from date.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Performs parameterized update of BLOB data in a table.

methods.name: updateBlobFile
methods.description: Updates BLOB data from a file into a table.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for generating unique IDs.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL to format date according to a specified format.
